indexing_rules: Exclude .git, _migration, ai/knowledge-index, templates, and canonical candidate metadata from indexed learning content.
Canonical concept pages are the reusable technical knowledge source of truth.
canonical_concept identifies the primary canonical owner of a document when applicable.
related_concepts identifies approved evidence-based relationships to canonical concepts.
Resource relationships are approved from repository evidence and validated against existing files.
Concept-to-concept relationships are maintained separately and require explicit evidence.
Do not infer relationships from filename similarity alone.
Do not index backup files, reports, templates, or migration copies as learning resources.
